contract: Pure pattern step for one graph callable: needs, gives and links set the order, a join does not wait for a skipped branch, map and loop are bounded, each outcome follows its link or fails the Run, and a settled node never runs again.
limits: One graph callable and one recorded input at a time; fixed bounds of 64 open actions, 64 concurrent map items, 256 items or iterations and 65,536 bytes of state; the reasons are fixed atoms and no input fragment appears in an error.
No retry, timeout rule, engine code, agent or decision logic, Lua, budget or authority check, person verification, schema validation of arguments or inputs, clock, I/O, process or storage.

Results in a different arrival order give the same set of actions and the same finish except the action_id of the finish, which names the completed action that settled last; a nested graph is another instance of this step that the host binds.

grounding.claim: The production node transition gives no start to a node that is open, done or skipped, for each value of the three Boolean operands; excludes the derivation of those operands from the links, and the items of a map and the iterations of a loop.
The pinned Cure compiler checks the total pure transition over four node states and three Booleans, its three-member result type and the named law.

Listed scenarios of the groups needs_and_gives_only, decision_branch_and_join, map_bounds_and_part_failure, loop_bounded, each_outcome_link, missing_outcome_link_fails_run, settled_node_never_runs_again, arrival_order, nested_graph_gets_only_its_input and new_refusals_and_closed pass, with two negative controls; finite tests, not a universal proof.
Relies on pinned Cure compilation, Boolean decisions and equality checking; compiler soundness is not locally proved.

The engine records each input before the step reads it, keeps the Run-wide id unique, binds each nested callable to the recipe it came from, and checks payload, budget, authority and approval for each action; the recipe has no need named item, index, iteration or previous on a map or loop node.

telemetry.contract: Pure step emits no observations; the engine owns instrumentation.

config.contract: Intrinsic spec operands and fixed bounds; no ambient settings.

control.contract: No independent process, lifecycle or operational commands; cancel and run_ended are pattern inputs.
